_comment: Frozen reference for a verified TCGA-PRAD build. Recorded 2026-09-01
against GDC Data Release 46.0 and the TCGA-CDR supplement (Liu 2018).
No cohort data is stored here - only counts, hashes and fitted
statistics, which is what makes this checkable without redistributing
controlled or bulky files. tests/test_golden.py compares a freshly
built cohort against it and skips when none is available.
population_hash is the strongest single value: it covers the exact
sample set every score is relative to, and is independent of the
expression values themselves. expr_checksum is deliberately NOT
asserted - it moves whenever GDC re-releases the underlying files,
which is a data change, not a regression.
scale_max_* is a wide band on purpose. It exists to separate a correctly
log2'd matrix (max ~16.6 here; peak TPM ~102k, normal in prostate where
KLK3 dominates) from a double-logged one (max ~4). Note the QC report's
range line is computed on a 200k-value subsample, so it reads lower than
the true maximum - expr_max below is the exact figure.
